title: SegRCDB: Semantic Segmentation via Formula-Driven Supervised Learning
mechanism: Pretrain a segmentation network on procedurally generated images and masks (radial contours), with no real images or manual labels.
adaptation: Replace radial contours with EL-like primitives: thin dark polylines (1-4 px, branching), dark blobs attached to lines (inactive), periodic gridlines and busbars on textured grey. Pretrain the house encoder+decoder on 100k images, then PF fine-tune.
min_experiment: Arm: formula-pretrained house net + PF fine-tune, 3 then 5 seeds. Baseline: ImageNet house PF. Metrics: test crack IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill: both n.d. after 3 seeds.
evidence: R: higher mIoU than COCO-Stuff pretraining at equal image count when fine-tuning on ADE20k and Cityscapes.
prior_overlap: none. MIM and DDeP pool pretraining were n.d., but those are different objectives on real images. InsCore (same lab) is covered by another direction.
